metadata.title: BGA — board game rules assistant
metadata.description: A local voice assistant that teaches board game rules from your own rulebooks.

home.title: Board game rules assistant
home.subtitle: Answers come only from the rulebooks, FAQs and errata indexed on this computer.

rulebooks.title: Rulebooks
rulebooks.subtitle: Load your own publisher PDFs on this computer. Nothing from someone else’s library is bundled.

starting.title: Preparing the assistant
starting.body: Loading search on this computer. The first time can take a few minutes. You can look around; questions about the rules will wait until this finishes.

offline.title: The assistant did not start
offline.body: Close the app and open it again.

engineOffline.title: The RAG engine is not responding
engineOffline.body: Start it with <command>pnpm dev</command> in the repository directory. The interface works, but without the engine there is nowhere to get the rules from.

game.label: Game
game.description: Answers use this game’s documents. Turn on expansions below only when you are playing with them.

expansions.description: Optional. Leave unticked for base rules only.
expansions.cleared: Expansion selection cleared for the new game.

question.label: Question
question.placeholder: Can I play an action card if I have no tiles left?

insufficientEvidence.title: No basis in the documents
insufficientEvidence.body: This answer is not covered by the indexed material. Add an errata or a FAQ for this game rather than treating the text above as a rule.

error.title: Engine error
error.unknown: The engine reported an error that has no description here yet.
error.engine_unreachable: Could not reach the local RAG engine.
error.stream_truncated: The answer stream stopped before it finished.
error.http_error: The engine responded with an error.
error.malformed_frame: The engine sent a frame that is not valid JSON.
error.unknown_event: The engine sent a frame that does not match the event contract.
error.generation_timeout: The model stopped producing words. Ask again, or check that Ollama is still running.
error.model_missing: A required local model is not installed. Download the models for this profile, then ask again.

notice.unknown: The engine reported a state that has no description here yet.
notice.engine_not_indexed:
There are no searchable documents for “{{gameId}}” yet. Import a rulebook PDF, then ask again.

Active model profile: {{profile}}.
notice.retrieval_not_ready: This computer can store rulebook pages, but search is not installed yet. In the project folder run: uv sync --extra ingest --extra retrieval
notice.retrieval_loading: Search is still starting on this computer. Wait a moment, then ask again.

setup.title: First-run setup
setup.subtitle: We check this computer and recommend a model profile. Page citation quality is the same on every profile — smaller machines only trade fluency for speed.

browserOnly.title: Model setup needs the desktop app
browserOnly.body: Checking hardware and downloading models works in the packaged desktop app. In the browser, open Rulebooks to import a PDF — start the stack with pnpm dev first.

profile.sharedRetrieval: Search and reranking models are identical on every profile, so the cited rulebook page stays equally accurate.
profile.diskNeed: About {{gib}} GB of disk will be used after models are downloaded.

minimal-16gb.title: Recommended: minimal (16 GB class)
minimal-16gb.body: A smaller language model. Answers stay grounded in the same pages, but wording is simpler, teaching is weaker, and “I don’t know” appears more often.

starter-32gb.title: Recommended: starter (32 GB class)
starter-32gb.body: The default build profile. Good balance of speed and explanation quality for settling rules at the table.

full-64gb.title: Recommended: full (64 GB class)
full-64gb.body: Largest local models, including an optional vision model later. Best fluency for teaching a new game out loud.

reason.full: This machine has enough memory for the full profile.
reason.starter: This machine matches the starter profile.
reason.minimal: This machine fits the minimal profile comfortably.
reason.insufficient_disk: Free disk space is low for the recommended profile. Free space before downloading models.
reason.insufficient_memory: Memory is below the comfortable minimum. The minimal profile is still offered, but answers may be slow or truncated.

ollama.missingBody: The language models run through Ollama on this computer. Install it, start it once, then reopen this app.
ollama.download: Download Ollama (opens in a new tab)

models.title: Model download
models.body: Models are downloaded with a visible progress step so the app never looks frozen. The installer itself stays small; the weights are several gigabytes.

diagnostics.saved: Saved to {{path}}. Send that file if something breaks — nothing is uploaded automatically.

pdfImport.title: Add a rulebook PDF
pdfImport.subtitle: You always load your own PDFs. Nothing from someone else’s library is bundled. Answers from those documents arrive in the next stage — for now the file is turned into searchable pages on this computer.

howAdding.helper: A second booklet, solo mode, or late supplement belongs under an existing game — use “Add to an existing game”. A new box or an expansion you bought later is a new game.

attachGame.selectDescription: Choose the game this PDF belongs to

gameId.label: Game id
gameId.description: Lowercase slug used as the folder name, for example azul or brass-birmingham

gameTitle.label: Game title
gameTitle.description: Shown in the game list. Defaults to the game id if left blank.

baseGame.label: This is an expansion of
baseGame.description: Optional. Leave empty for a standalone or base game. Only base games appear here.

documentTitle.label: Document title
documentTitle.description: A short name people understand, for example Rulebook, Solo mode, or Living rules May 2024
documentTitle.requiredAttach: Required when adding to an existing game

communityFaq.label: Also fetch BoardGameGeek description text
communityFaq.description: Uses the official XML API only. Never downloads rulebook PDFs from BGG Files. Needs internet; skipping it never blocks the PDF import.

drop.title: Drop a PDF here
drop.body: Drag a publisher rulebook onto this area, or choose a file. Pages are rendered and text is split into sections on this computer.
drop.keyboardHint: To add a file with the keyboard, use Choose PDF.

success.title: Rulebook imported
success.body: “{{gameId}}” is on the game list. You can ask about this rulebook; answers cite the page.

error.invalidGameIdBody: Use a lowercase slug: letters, digits and hyphens only, starting with a letter or digit.
error.unknownGameBody: Choose a game that is already on the list, or switch to New game.
error.invalidDocumentTitleBody: Type a short title for this PDF so it can be told apart from other booklets.
error.invalidBaseGameBody: Pick a base game from the list, or leave expansion unset.
error.invalidDocKeyBody: Use a lowercase slug: letters, digits and hyphens only.
error.invalidFileBody: Choose a publisher rulebook saved as a PDF.
error.ingestNotReadyBody: Received “{{fileName}}”, but PDF tools are not installed in the engine environment. Run uv sync --extra ingest in services/rag-engine, then try again.
error.engineUnreachableBody: Start the app with pnpm dev so the web interface and the engine are both running, then try again.
error.limitExceededBody: This file is over 80 MB or has more than 200 pages. Use a smaller publisher PDF.
error.pageImageTooLargeTitle: A page image is too heavy
error.pageImageTooLargeBody: One page still makes a picture larger than 5 MB even after lowering resolution. Try a lighter scan or a smaller publisher PDF.
error.ingestFailedBody: The file could not be turned into pages. Try another PDF, or check the engine log.
error.indexFailedBody: The PDF is on this computer, but it could not be added to search (Ollama may be stopped). Start Ollama, then run: uv run python -m rag_engine.ingest index
error.ingestBusyBody: Wait until the current rulebook finishes, then try again.
